data.one_liner: Generates image thumbnails from local video files, URLs, or assets.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that creates video thumbnails returning them either as raw bytes in memory or saved as a file. It supports JPEG, PNG, and WEBP formats across Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
use_when: You need to display a video preview image or grid of video thumbnails in your app.
You want to generate thumbnails from remote video URLs or local files.
avoid_when: The video hosting server on the web lacks CORS headers or HTTP range requests support.
You need a full video playback solution rather than just static thumbnails.
strengths: Supports both in-memory bytes and file output.
Works on Android, iOS, and Web.
Provides control over image format, dimensions, and quality.
weaknesses: Web usage has strict requirements regarding server CORS headers and HTTP range headers.
Known minor performance issues generating WebP thumbnails on iOS using libwebp.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. No extra native permissions are strictly required just to generate a thumbnail from a path or URL.
